# BoxCompute

> Isolated Linux VM Sandboxes grouped by persistent workspaces, for AI agents
> that build, test, and explore.

Hosted BoxCompute is invite-only. A 15-minute call requests your invite.

## API

- Base URL: `https://api.boxcompute.ai` (public v2 routes under `/api/v2`)
- OpenAPI 3.1: `https://api.boxcompute.ai/api/v2/openapi.json`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer bc_live_...` (scoped keys, see `/auth.md`)
